corpus.name: controlled_gate_c2_chain_validation_v3
corpus.vocabulary_domain: rivers (V4 birds, v1 minerals, v2 constellations)

forbidden: rerunning v1/v2 corpora and calling it validation
holdout_policy: c2_cal_holdout remains UNTOUCHED, reserved for the finished lower pipeline.
on_pass: promote BOUNDED_CHAIN_COMPLETION and freeze candidate generation, then pools -> ceilings -> S0/S5. Nothing else.

primary_metric.name: OracleGapClosure
primary_metric.question: Of the performance a better next retrieval operation could theoretically recover, how much does the real mechanism recover?
primary_metric.why_uniform: Per-regime absolute deltas caused both prior failures: v1 demanded absolute gain from a saturated diagnostic, v2 transplanted an encoder-calibrated bar onto a chain-completion endpoint. The intervention is chain completion, so it is judged by how much chain-completion opportunity it captures. tau is a minimum meaningful effect size chosen before any v3 number exists, NOT selected from whichever regime barely passes.

purpose: Validate the FIXED C4 mechanism under a correctly normalized protocol on a fourth disjoint corpus. v1 and v2 were used to discover the appropriate endpoint; that is legitimate exploratory science and is why validation needs fresh data.
replication_requirement: must hold on both predeclared partitions
residual_chain_length: measured as an EXPLANATORY variable only; never a pass threshold

saturation_rule.why: A regime already at the ceiling cannot show gap closure; demanding it is ill-posed.
